configurations.name: expo-web-local
runtimeArgs: export PATH=$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v24.19.0/bin:$PATH CI=1 BROWSER=none; export EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:54321; export EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=$(npx supabase status -o env 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/^ANON_KEY="\(.*\)"$/\1/p'); exec node node_modules/.bin/expo start --web --port 8081 --clear
